title: Falling and Catching in a Trot: A Body on Two Feet as an Inverted Pendulum, and How Long a Stance May Last Before the Next Feet Must Land

questions.question: Why is a trot always falling?
options: With two feet down there is no support polygon, only a line, and the body falls toward one side until the other pair lands

questions.question: A body 10 mm off the line took how long to fall 6 cm?
What does a taller body do?
options: Falls more slowly: 0.50 s for 0.40 m

questions.question: A stance of 0.25 s with the centre 30 mm off the line was:
What does a negative time mean?
options: The centre is moving back toward the line fast enough that it never gets there

questions.question: What is not in the model?
options: Where the swing feet land and the body's rotation
